description: Detect which GTM tools a company uses from its public website. Returns CRM, sequencer, and marketing automation signals with per-tool boolean flags as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Deprecated alias for domain, accepted by the actor for older callers. Prefer domain.

crawl_additional_pages.description: Crawl up to 2 extra pages for better coverage. Defaults to true when omitted.

domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Supply this, company_domain or url.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

skipCache.description: By default a clean detection is cached for 7 days and reused. Set true to force a fresh detection.

technologies.description: Report only these tools. Omit to report every detectable tool. Only tools with a client side fingerprint are selectable. Detection is unchanged, so filtering costs nothing extra.

url.description: Deprecated alias for domain, accepted by the actor as a full company website URL. Prefer domain.

name: detect_gtm_tech_stack
title: Detect GTM Tech Stack
